interpretation: These are fictional regression and demonstration results, not independent real-world gold or a cross-library ranking.
Errors in context40 and the observed synthetic test informed rule and identity corrections; a fresh unseen annotated corpus is required for external quality estimates.
Validation supported retaining NarrativeRecognizer; test was not used to select model thresholds.
The domain pack returned no automatically approved documents; an approved-leak rate with no approvals is null, not zero.
The final test still has 113/600 documents with annotated direct-identifier leakage, despite 97.419% direct-character removal and 99.196% nonsensitive retention.
Declared relation fidelity measures graph storage/evidence, not automatic relation extraction or inferred coreference.
Posttraining adapts its own fictional baseline and stays blocked and inactive; classifier improvement did not change zero observed output leakage.
Reports contain aggregate metrics and digests, no raw text, reidentification maps, cryptographic keys or model weights.
csv_line_endings: CSV projections are stored with canonical LF line endings; CLI CSV writer output may use CRLF before repository normalization.
